findings.note: Bulls guard Norman Powell (hamstring) is ruled out of Saturday's game against the Pacers, his fourth straight absence. CBS lists Tre Jones among the players who could get more minutes, which could push his combined total over the line.

Jones's last five games (Nov 18-25, 2026) add up to 18, 20, 15, 29 and 22 combined points, rebounds and assists, so he topped 18.5 in three of five. His minutes swung from 12 to 27, and his season page averages work out to about 17.6, just under the line.

Jones's 2026 averages through 14 games are 10.9 points, 2.1 rebounds and 3.4 assists in 19.0 minutes, about 16.4 combined, below 18.5. CBS's season projection is lower still, at about 13.3 combined in 18.3 minutes.
